library: aspire_annex skill library (code-as-policy, annex installation = bending-elastic cord on a table, tool holds one end)

skills.failure_signature: after a fast pull the tool stops; within 0.1 s the cord's kinetic-energy proxy drops by >80% (life 2: 12.8 -> 1.4), total bend rises from <0.5 to >4 rad, the tip whips towards the tool and stalls 0.1-0.3 m from it, then the cord slowly re-straightens along its near part (back where it came from)
skills.when_to_apply: any program that throws the cord with a single out-stroke and a stop (v1-v3)
skills.repair_strategy: do not end the stroke with a plain stop; reverse the tool immediately (haul) so the attached leg is pulled back while the free leg still flies forward
skills.code_sketch: if phase=='out' and (tool-F)@d >= frac*L: phase='back'; return F   # command the start point again at full rate
skills.status: validated partially: haul put the tip 0.25 m ahead of the tool and the cord ended pointing forward (life 5), first time in 5 lives; confirmed in the extended run (all casts with a haul got the tip ahead)

skills.failure_signature: strike planned perpendicular to the cord, but the tool lags its reference badly (|v_tool| ~1.5-2 m/s vs 4 m/s reference) and the near points move with the tool along the strike; the far part barely moves (life 3)
skills.when_to_apply: estimating which way the cord lies at the tool before a strike
skills.repair_strategy: use the direction of the last few segments (p20 -> p15), not the tool->centroid direction; a curled cord can lie along the strike near the tool even when its centroid is off to the side

skills.failure_signature: tool speed saturates far below the reference (force limit 60 N) when the stroke drives into or across the cord
skills.repair_strategy: strike so the cord is pulled (stroke direction pointing away from the near part); a pull along the cord reached 3.5 m/s with every point moving together (life 2), a push did not

skills.failure_signature: the preparation move carries the tool towards the cord; tip-tool distance does not grow during the stroke start; the first part of the stroke only takes up slack
skills.repair_strategy: choose S with (S - tool0) . r <= 0 (move away from or across the cord, never into it) and approach S slowly

skills.failure_signature: tool drives 0.9 m of path but the tip moves <0.25 m and only while the cord is taut (tip-tool ~0.7)
skills.when_to_apply: any slow kinematic plan (laying a track, pushing the cord out tip-first, slow dragging)
skills.repair_strategy: abandon: slow work leaves the tip where it is ('doing it slowly gets you nowhere'); the tip only moves when pulled taut or thrown

skills.failure_signature: after a throw the cord ends straight (chord 0.65-0.70 m) but pointing where its near part pointed after the throw, reached by a slow (0.3-0.5 m/s, ~1.5-2 s) elastic straightening
skills.when_to_apply: predicting where the tip comes to rest
skills.repair_strategy: aim the near part (the leg attached to the tool after the haul), and allow ~2 s of holding still before the episode ends; a one-shot estimate: tip at rest ~ tool + 0.66 * direction(near part)

skills.failure_signature: tip rests beyond the target on the line through the tool
skills.when_to_apply: after the cord has stopped, tip farther from the tool than the target and roughly on the tool-target line
skills.repair_strategy: pull the tool slowly along (target - tip) until |tip-target| < 0.035 or the distance stops decreasing, then hold; BUG found in life 3: the 'beyond' test must also require (tip-tool).(target-tool) > 0 and |tip-tool| > |target-tool|, otherwise it fires when the tip lies behind the tool

the target sits 0.12 m straight behind the post (radially from the zone centre); keep the line from the parked tool to the aim point >= 0.035 m from the post centre and aim at a point of the disc offset sideways by 0.05 m
skills.code_sketch: A = target + side*0.05*lat; require seg_dist(post, F, A) >= 0.035
skills.status: geometry only; the swing-into-post idea (v4) was never properly tested because of S2

skills.failure_signature: cast line opposite to the near part (p20->p14) but the cord's mass lies off to one side: resting direction 140 deg off (x1-2, near mis 1.9 deg, centroid mis +26.5 deg)
skills.repair_strategy: pick the valid cast line most opposite to the tool->centroid direction; across lives 2, 5, x1-2 the sign of the resting deviation followed the sign of the centroid misalignment
skills.code_sketch: lie = atan2(*(pts.mean(0)-pts[19])[::-1]); mis = wrap(lie - (d+180)); pick argmin |mis|
skills.status: validated: with |mis_cen| < 10 deg the tip flew straight at the target on seed 62 (x1-3, x2-4, x2-5, x3-1, x3-2)

skills.failure_signature: stroke 0.12 m: tip peak 1.3 m/s, no whip; 0.20 m: tip stalls 0.26 m short; 0.23 m: stalls against the post; 0.25-0.27 m: tip reaches the target at 0.8-4.5 m/s
skills.when_to_apply: setting the stroke length (full-rate triangular stroke, tool peak ~sqrt(60 L))
skills.repair_strategy: use L ~0.25-0.27 m: the whip has a sharp threshold between 0.20 and 0.25 m; below it nothing reaches the target
skills.code_sketch: G = F + 0.27*d; switch to haul at 55% of the stroke
skills.status: validated on one situation (seed 62); only ~26/200 layouts leave room for >= 0.22 m

skills.failure_signature: tip enters the target disc at the cord's turnover with flight chord 0.61 m (0.608/0.611/0.609), then recoils past the tool at 2-4 m/s
skills.repair_strategy: follow through: when the tip is ahead, chord > 0.42 m and still opening > 1 m/s, move the tool 0.08 m towards the tip at full rate (park 0.58 m from the aim point to compensate); a chord-servo that pulls the tool BACK (v15) did not help, and firing earlier with 0.12 m (v18) did not help either
skills.code_sketch: if ahead and chord > 0.42 and vout > 1 and not gave: hold += 0.08*unit(tip-tool)
skills.status: partially validated: x3-2 kept the cord out (0.30 m final, best extended life)

skills.failure_signature: tip or cord grazes the post (point-post distance <= 0.037 m) just as it slows near the target, then the cord collapses back towards the tool
skills.when_to_apply: choosing the line beside the post
skills.repair_strategy: the flight path lies 0.03-0.07 m off the straight F->A line, so clearance 0.035-0.05 m is not enough; use >= 0.08 m (not flown); aiming AT the post to let it catch the cord (v16) failed because the cord missed it by 0.07 m

skills.failure_signature: curled cord (chord < 0.45 m at the strike): no whip, tip peak ~2 m/s (x3-4, chord 0.375)
skills.repair_strategy: walk the tool slowly (0.5 m/s) straight away from the tip until the chord is 0.62 m, then re-plan and cast
skills.status: validated: chord 0.375 -> 0.58, whip formed, tip reached 0.124 m from the target (then post contact)
